summary.name: 美果123
summary.one_liner: A domain parking page (run by the DraonParking platform) that lists premium Chinese-market domain names for sale at fixed prices.
use_cases: finding a domain name to buy
browsing domains for sale in China
sourcing brandable names for a startup
summary.what_it_does: The page is a parking page for domain names offered at fixed prices (一口价). It shows a 'today's picks' list of about ten domains, each with a name, a label or description, and a price in RMB, ranging from 888 yuan to 3,330,000 yuan. Examples include dandan.com, lucina.cn, and milandu.com. The page text gives no details on how to purchase, escrow, or contact the seller. It is operated by the DraonParking domain parking platform, according to its meta description.
notable: Fixed-price (一口价) domain listings priced in RMB
Operated by the DraonParking domain parking platform
Lists mostly .cn and .com domains with Chinese-language labels
caveats: Page text does not explain the purchase or transfer process
Listed prices are for domains only; no fees or terms are shown
Listing in the source collection is tagged #freemium, but the page itself does not state any pricing model for users
